svg.title: The data landscape
svg.desc: Four candidate engines positioned by pipeline complexity (tabular to multimodal) and data volume (megabytes to petabytes): Polars/DuckDB for single-node tabular speed, DataFusion for embeddable extensibility, Spark/Dask for petabyte-scale reliability, and Ray/Daft for distributed multimodal GPU work.
